free_cash_flow.label: Free Cash Flow
free_cash_flow.definition: Cash generated after operating costs and required capital investment.

drawdown.label: Drawdown
drawdown.definition: Percentage decline from a recent peak price to the current price.

margin_of_safety.label: Margin of Safety
margin_of_safety.definition: Discount between market price and estimated intrinsic value.

value_score.label: Value Score
value_score.definition: Composite valuation score. Rewards stocks trading at a discount to sector-median P/E (earnings yield), P/B (price-to-book), EV/EBITDA, and to model-estimated fair value. Also scores FCF yield and PEG ratio. Higher = more undervalued relative to fundamentals.

quality_score.label: Quality Score
quality_score.definition: Business quality score based on ROE, ROA, gross margin, operating margin, and net profit margin. Negative returns and margins are penalized, not neutralised. Higher = stronger and more consistent profitability.

risk_score.label: Risk Score
risk_score.definition: Model score for financial resilience. Higher score = stronger balance sheet, lower financial risk. Lower score = elevated risk. A score below 52 signals moderate financial stress; below 40 signals high risk.

dip_score.label: Dip Score
dip_score.definition: Price context score based on position within the 52-week range. Higher score = price is closer to its 52-week low (more depressed entry point). Lower score = price is near its 52-week high.

confidence.label: Confidence
confidence.definition: Data-quality confidence based on completeness of source fundamentals and analyst coverage depth. Higher = scores are more reliable. Lower = treat scores with additional caution.

fair_value.label: Fair Value
fair_value.definition: Model-estimated intrinsic value. Uses analyst price target if available and plausible, otherwise forward-earnings multiple, otherwise book-value multiple. Used as the benchmark for the Discount calculation.

discount_pct.label: Discount
discount_pct.definition: How far the stock trades below its estimated fair value. Positive = undervalued (stock is below fair value, potential upside). Negative = stock is trading above estimated fair value.

market_cap.label: Market Capitalization
market_cap.definition: Total market value of equity outstanding, calculated as share price multiplied by shares outstanding.

pe_ratio.label: Price to Earnings Ratio (P/E)
pe_ratio.definition: Share price divided by earnings per share.

peg_ratio.label: PEG Ratio
peg_ratio.definition: P/E ratio adjusted by earnings growth rate.

price_to_book.label: Price to Book Ratio (P/B)
price_to_book.definition: Share price divided by book value per share.

debt_to_equity.label: Debt to Equity Ratio
debt_to_equity.definition: Total debt divided by shareholder equity.

roe.label: Return on Equity (ROE)
roe.definition: Net income divided by shareholder equity.

roic.label: Return on Invested Capital (ROIC)
roic.definition: After-tax operating profit divided by invested capital.

free_cash_flow_yield.label: Free Cash Flow Yield
free_cash_flow_yield.definition: Free cash flow per share relative to current share price.

dividend_yield.label: Dividend Yield
dividend_yield.definition: Annual dividend per share divided by current share price.

payout_ratio.label: Payout Ratio
payout_ratio.definition: Dividends paid as a share of net earnings.

current_ratio.label: Current Ratio
current_ratio.definition: Current assets divided by current liabilities.

quick_ratio.label: Quick Ratio
quick_ratio.definition: Liquid current assets divided by current liabilities.

eps_growth.label: EPS Growth
eps_growth.definition: Growth rate of earnings per share over time.

revenue_growth.label: Revenue Growth
revenue_growth.definition: Growth rate of company revenue over time.

operating_margin.label: Operating Margin
operating_margin.definition: Operating income as a percentage of revenue.

net_margin.label: Net Profit Margin
net_margin.definition: Net income as a percentage of revenue.

interest_coverage.label: Interest Coverage Ratio
interest_coverage.definition: Operating earnings relative to interest expense.

tangible_book_value_per_share.label: Tangible Book Value Per Share
tangible_book_value_per_share.definition: Net tangible assets divided by shares outstanding.

ncav.label: Net Current Asset Value (NCAV)
ncav.definition: Current assets minus total liabilities, often used in deep value analysis.

altman_z_score.label: Altman Z Score
altman_z_score.definition: Composite bankruptcy-risk indicator based on balance sheet and earnings ratios.

piotroski_f_score.label: Piotroski F Score
piotroski_f_score.definition: Nine-point scoring system for financial strength and trend quality.

beneish_m_score.label: Beneish M Score
beneish_m_score.definition: Forensic accounting indicator that flags potential earnings manipulation risk.
